body:
INSTAGRAM
One prompt for emails people actually reply to: shorter, clearer, ask up front, still sounds like you.
Most emails bury the ask under three paragraphs of context. This prompt moves it into the first two lines, halves the length and gives you a warm and a direct version to pick from.

The prompt (paste into Claude, claude.ai):
"Rewrite this to be shorter and clearer. Keep my tone. Give me 2 versions: one warm, one direct. Put the ask in the first 2 lines. [paste draft]"
Tricky one? Slide 4 has the prompt for saying no, chasing and pushing back.

Save this one. Follow @manrajtalks for practical Claude tips you can use the same day.
